title: Huuger 63 X 24 Inch Electric Standing Desk with Power Outlets and USB-C Port, Height Adjustable Desk, Sit Stand Desk for Home Office, Computer & Gaming Desk with 4 Presets, Stable Steel Frame, White
reviews: I’ve been enjoying my desk so far. Works well, great price. The black desk top material is very sensitive to oils and lotions, so it can look very greasy. I would advise getting a desk mat.
This product is very nice I hope it lasts a while but overall pretty sweet
This was an amazing investment I love how it fits into my room and makes it look more spacious would recommend
Very easy to put together. Doesn't cost more than its worth.
Super easy to put together. Although I have not officially used it yet, I like everything about it.
Great desk for the price, and easy to put together.

The instructions just want you to forcefully screw into wood in order to connect the panels, they should have just gave you the entire board, making us do this extra work just to reduce package size slightly is inconsiderate in my opinion though I did give bonus star for a good instruction manual

Function: Great standing desk. This rises almost 48" which is perfect for me to stand during a video call and still comfortably type. The control module has 3 presets and works every time without issue. Assembly is very simple and even comes with additional spare screws and all tools which is rare. Legs and motors: The motor is fast and the legs are sturdy. The paint is top notch and didn't flinch when I accidentally dropped some tools on the legs while assembly. Everything is perfectly calibrated and after I put this together, it was perfectly level without any wobbles. Desktop and power tap: Sufficient for casual use, but it is a split top design. This is not unusual for the price but I can't help but reminisce about older sold wood designs. The particleboard may hold up well if not abused, but my eye and hands are drawn to the center where the 2 tabletops meet. The power tap is also fairly spartan. The ports work but there's no surge protection and overall feels light. I wish it had a dedicated low voltage on the bottom so that the motor can plug into it directly instead of taking up 1 AC port on the surface of the desk. Overall: Excellent value and great functionality. I may be being too harsh by critiquing the tabletop at this price point, but it's just a strange concept to me even if it is mainstream now. The good news is since, the legs are so stout, there's nothing preventing replacing the tabletop altogether if you already have one.
